design_philosophy: Clinical Precision meets Artificial Intelligence. The UI must feel like an advanced, highly sterile, yet incredibly powerful biomedical research tool. Utilizing generous white space, structural bento grids, bold authoritative typography, and a strict medical-blue color palette to evoke trust and high technology. Eradicate all 'demo' or 'toy' aesthetics.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-slate-900 leading-tight

typography.specific_instructions: Title 'BioKG Text AI' must always be displayed in the boldest weight (font-black) with tight letter spacing. Do not use generic Inter for headings.

grid_modes.dashboard_control_room: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 shadow-sm

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-blue-600 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.outline: inline-flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-slate-200 bg-transparent text-slate-900 font-semibold rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:border-blue-600 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
cards.bento_marketing: bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden relative group

file_upload.container: relative border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-12 text-center hover:bg-blue-50 hover:border-blue-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer group
file_upload.icon: w-12 h-12 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-blue-500 mx-auto mb-4 transition-colors
file_upload.format_badge: px-2 py-1 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded text-xs font-mono text-slate-600 shadow-sm

inputs.text_area: w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 resize-none
inputs.text_field: w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20

output_display.container: bg-slate-900 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-inner relative overflow-hidden
output_display.header_bar: flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-700 pb-3 mb-4
output_display.copy_button: p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors

history_panel.item: flex items-start gap-4 p-4 border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors

visual_enhancers.background_texture: Subtle grid pattern or radial gradient meshes using pure white and very light slate (e.g., bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-blue-50 via-white to-white) for marketing pages to prevent flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for the top sticky navigation header and overlapping floating stat cards on the hero section. Requires 1px inner border of white/40 to pop.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for marketing (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]). Crisp, small shadows for dashboard elements (shadow-sm).
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React icons with stroke-width 1.5. Essential icons: UploadCloud, Network, Microsope, FileText, Activity, Database, History, LayoutDashboard, Copy, CheckCircle.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue and white organic molecular structure. Used in the Hero Section to immediately establish the advanced pharmaceutical AI aesthetic.
Abstract white background with vertical lines. Use as a background for the 'How It Works' or 'Features' bento grid container to add depth.
Blue background with lines and dots representing a knowledge graph. Use as the side-panel image in the Authentication (Login/Signup) split layout.
Woman looking through a microscope in a lab. Use in a trust/testimonial section or 'Built for Researchers' block.

accessibility_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and interactive cards must have distinct hover states (transform -translate-y-0.5 and increased shadow for cards, bg darkening for buttons).
accessibility_and_interactions.focus_states: Form inputs must have a clear 2px focus ring using the primary blue color.
accessibility_and_interactions.contrast: Text contrast must meet WCAG AA. Slate-500 minimum for small text, Slate-600/900 for body/headers.
accessibility_and_interactions.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-kg-dropzone', data-testid='generate-text-button', data-testid='copy-output-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application strictly using standard React + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn components.
Implement the 'BioKG Text AI' title explicitly with the 'font-black' class from Cabinet Grotesk (or substitute with your boldest available sans-serif if not installed, but tracking must be tight).

For the KG-to-Text generation section, include a split or tabbed interface allowing users to either paste raw text or use the drag-and-drop file upload zone (must clearly mention CSV, JSON, TTL formats in the UI).
Replace generic demo text with professional pharmaceutical/AI copy (e.g., 'Synthesizing knowledge graph triples into natural language clinical insights...').
Implement the user dashboard and admin analytics with dense, data-rich 'Control Room' grid layouts (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 or 4) utilizing Shadcn cards and Recharts if necessary.
Ensure the hero section uses the provided 'hero_visual' image creatively (e.g., inside a beautifully rounded container with a subtle shadow, or overlapping the layout).
